patthana18.7:1.1: hetuṃ sārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na sārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.7:2.1: na hetuṃ anārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na anārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.7:3.1: na hetuṃ cittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu no citto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.7:4.1: hetuṃ no cittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na no citto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.7:5.1: hetuṃ cetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na cetasiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.7:6.1: na hetuṃ acetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na acetasiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.7:7.1: hetuṃ cittaspayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na cittasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.7:8.1: na hetuṃ cittavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na cittavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.7:9.1: hetuṃ cittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na cittasaṃsaṭṭho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.7:10.1: na hetuṃ cittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na cittasaṃṭṭho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi. hetuyā cha.
patthana18.7:11.1: hetuṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu no cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.7:12.1: na hetuṃ no cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu no cittasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.7:13.1: hetuṃ cittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu no cittasahabhu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.7:14.1: na hetuṃ no cittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na no cittasahabhu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.7:15.1: hetuṃ cittānuparivattiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu no cittānuparivatti dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.7:16.1: na hetuṃ no cittānuparivattiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na no cittānuparivatti dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.7:17.1: hetuṃ cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.7:18.1: na hetuṃ no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.7:19.1: hetuṃ cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.7:20.1: na hetuṃ no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhū dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.7:21.1: hetuṃ cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivatti dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi. na hetuṃ no
patthana18.7:22.1: cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānuparivattiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivatti dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi. (saṃkhittaṃ) …pe… (nayavasena vitthāretabbaṃ.)
